authorization: Same five new cycles; two previously valid AB-P; C03 one of three residual new slots; 2 historical unchanged

DRIFT.reason: From verified synthetic opportunity/display observation to grouped ranking-room assignment and target-weighting changes; no new real empirical population.

research_contract.A: Can a four-arm individual-level ranking comparison remain interpretable if peers in one shared room receive different treatment assignments, and do equal-cluster vs equal-person target contrasts agree with unequal room sizes?

B.H1: Treatment mixing inside shared leaderboard group is contamination/inconsistent cluster-level treatment; unequal room weights change estimates if estimand not specified.
B.H0: No contamination and person-weighted and cluster-equal factorial contrasts remain equal in the fixed fixture.
B.rival: Four independent arms assigned per individual may be legitimate only with exposure mapping and interference model; this diagnostic explicitly does not prove cluster randomization is the only defensible design.

C.pattern: control 0/1 and 3/3; transparency 1/1 and 0/3; leaderboard 0/1 and 0/3; both 1/1 and 3/3
negative_cases: mixed arms within same leaderboard room

D.environment: Node v22.16.0 local isolated container; no requests or network

research_contract.E: Execute exact frozen test with node only after prereg commit; record stdout, stderr, exit status, sha256.
research_contract.F: Adversarial assess contamination, unequal-room weights, post-hoc reweighting, no independent exposure/authenticated randomization; classify all crafted success/negative appropriately.
research_contract.G: Check conceptual prior art independently using Felkey et al 2023 AEA (anonymity and rank), Chen et al 2024 Labour Economics (small leagues), Karabiber & Gurol 2026 Acta Psychologica (6 arm rank vs progress); no scientific replication.
research_contract.H: Record cumulative prior revision on interference and estimator target, without increasing N1/N2/N3.
research_contract.I: Engineering result only, not identification of real leaderboard effects, inferential precision, statistical significance or ethical clearance.
research_contract.J: Count C03 as 1 AB-P valid ONLY if all prereg groups pass exact Git-matched code. If failure preserve result and repair via separate freeze. C04/C05 remain reserved unless independently justified.
